beneficiary.footerNote: You're receiving this because you have a beneficiary profile on the OKÜ payouts platform.

READY_FOR_REVIEW.subject: OKÜ approval — your beneficiary profile is in review
READY_FOR_REVIEW.headline: Your profile is in review
READY_FOR_REVIEW.body: Thanks — we have everything we need for now. Our finance team will review your beneficiary profile and let you know once OKÜ approval is complete.

OKU_APPROVED.subject: OKÜ approval — your beneficiary profile has been approved
OKU_APPROVED.headline: OKÜ has approved your profile
OKU_APPROVED.body: Good news — OKÜ Finance has approved your beneficiary profile. The next step is bank readiness: Banesco will review your file as part of their own onboarding before any payout is issued.

BANK_READY.subject: Bank readiness — Banesco has confirmed your account
BANK_READY.headline: Your account is bank-ready
BANK_READY.body: Banesco has confirmed your beneficiary file. You're now eligible to receive payouts on the next payout batch that includes you.

ON_HOLD.subject: Action needed — your beneficiary profile is on hold
ON_HOLD.headline: Your profile is on hold
ON_HOLD.body: We've placed a temporary compliance hold on your beneficiary profile. Payouts will resume once the hold is cleared. Please review the reason below and reach out if you have questions.

REJECTED.subject: Action needed — your beneficiary profile was rejected
REJECTED.headline: Your profile was rejected
REJECTED.body: We were unable to accept your beneficiary profile as submitted. Please review the reason below; you can update your details and resubmit at any time.
